stemMarkdown: A boat whose speed in still water is 10 km/h rows 60 km downstream and returns to the starting point. If the stream flows at 2 km/h, find the total time taken (in hours). (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Downstream: $\dfrac{60}{12} = 5.0000$ hours. Upstream: $\dfrac{60}{8} = 7.5000$ hours. Total $= 12.5$ hours.
altSolutionMarkdown: The return trip always takes longer than the outward one, so the round trip is never just twice the still-water time.
